Queue, intrabar event order, market impact, and liquidation latency remain unmodeled.

next_research_proposal.first_principles: Prior-session option OI/EOD volume concentration may mark inventory/hedging-relevant strike zones. Unsigned OI cannot identify dealer direction, so levels are context zones and direction comes from subsequent futures price acceptance/rejection.
features: Separate calls and puts by expiration and moneyness.
Build prior published-session strike concentration bands and normalize by underlying price/ATR.
Map QQQ/SPY strikes to MNQ/MES context with contemporaneous underlying ratio; preserve mapping timestamp.
Use completed 5m touch/rejection or reclaim as the trigger; evaluate exits at profile center/next band, causal invalidation, and fixed time cap.
next_research_proposal.research_splits: 2021 warmup/context; 2022–2023 calibration; 2024–2025 validation; 2026 retrospective data through frozen cutoff; 2026-09-24 onward held as strict prospective only.
next_research_proposal.gates: Paired net and 14-tick stress, shared walk-forward/Monte Carlo, date-cluster uncertainty, best-day removal, 12-month coverage, and Topstep real-time MLL path including unrealized P&L.
next_research_proposal.option_execution_limit: Use actual 1m option quotes only within their seven-month window; five-year study scores executable futures price action with lagged option context.
